rules: For each, check if an exemption exists in this registry (by file + function)
If not in registry => FAIL with 'unregistered optional context'
If in registry but is_user_triggered=true => FAIL with 'user-triggered requires context'
If in registry but can_change_critical_state=true and no audit in code => WARNING with 'material mutation audit check'
If in registry and all validations pass => PASS
If any exemption violates validation_rules => FAIL
